text:
zoe (People Ops): Quick check  candidate for Senior Backend role is a parent with school pickup at 3:15pm. They asked if we can finish the onsite loop by 2:45pm latest. Can we compress schedule and avoid evening social? cc @mike @lana
mike (Recruiter): Noted. Panelists are available 9:30-3:00. We can do 9:30 kickoff, two technical interviews, lunch break, then final loop 1:30-2:30. That should hit 2:45 end.
lana (Hiring Manager): I can condense my portion to 30 mins. Can we make sure final debrief is async so we don't hold candidate? Also they requested a Windows laptop for an IDE pairing task.
facilities-bot: Room booking: Conf C booked 9:20-15:00. Quiet room reserved 9:00-9:25 for candidate prep. Catering: boxed lunch ordered; dietary prefs requested.
security-bot: Visitor registration link: https://badge.redwood.example/visitor?ref=2159991234. Laptop loaner note: on-prem loaners require MDM enrollment. See IT policy: https://internal.redwood/it/device-policy
zoe (People Ops): Action items: 1) Mike to confirm candidate wants loaner or will bring own device. 2) Mike to confirm preferred IDE or language runtime. 3) Zoe to add note on invites: "Candidate needs to leave by 2:45 for school pickup".
mike (Recruiter): Confirmed: candidate will accept a loaner. Prefers VS Code + Go runtime. I'll add that to IT ticket and bring MDM enrollment docs.
zoe (People Ops): Expense snippet for childcare reimbursements (ad-hoc): "Childcare stipend up to $60 for same-day pickup; use code 'care-2159' in Expensify." Please add to calendar invite.
lana (Hiring Manager): One more ask: can interviewers avoid scheduling follow-ups after 3pm that might involve travel? we don't want them to reschedule candidate.
zoe (People Ops): Got it. I've updated invites, added childcare stipend note, and flagged IT for loaner image prep. Conf C map + pickup instructions on calendar. Closing: candidate confirmed, schedule compressed, loaner requested, stipend noted. Thanks! :smile:
